body: PageSpy makes debugging pages embedded in tablets and specialized hardware much easier. We can reproduce and diagnose issues without visiting the device or setting up a packet capture workflow.
PageSpy keeps improving with clear and timely releases. It gave us useful ideas while building our own debugging tools.
We use PageSpy in client projects. It is easy to set up, supports many stacks, and removes repetitive debugging work.
PageSpy simplified our frontend and QA debugging workflow. We no longer need to install different proxy certificates on every phone, saving our team significant time.
PageSpy makes development debugging much easier. I can inspect logs on a computer and share screenshots with backend developers instead of uploading phone photos.
The deployment options work well, and PageSpy helps reproduce the exact scene and logs. The community has always provided helpful support.
PageSpy addresses major web debugging problems: inspecting data, copying details, and debugging remotely. Offline logs and desktop review improve team efficiency.
This open-source project solves a real problem in complex customer environments. It saves time and makes debugging much more efficient.
